subject: Capacity true-up and one-off settlement for Streamforge
messages:
From: Lee Park <lee.park@streamforge.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@streamforge.com, jenna.alvarez@streamforge.com
Date: 2026-09-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity true-up and unexpected one-off charge

Hi Hannah,

We were reviewing our September invoice and see a one-time charge labelled "retro usage reconciliation - Aug/Sept" that is higher than what we expected. The line item total is $18,700 versus the $9,200 estimate we got during renewal. Can you help reconcile where the delta came from?

Attached is a quick export from our side showing the peak GPU hours by service. We'd like to understand if this is an accounting true-up (post-renewal top-up) or an overage (billing system mismatch). If it's a true-up, we need the mutual action items and a formal summary we can route to procurement for PO.

Thanks — Lee

Attachment: streamforge_usage_export_sep.csv (csv, 85 KB)

--
Lee Park
Head of Platform Operations
Streamforge Inc.
lee.park@streamforge.com
+1 (415) 555-0117
From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Lee Park <lee.park@streamforge.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-26T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity true-up and unexpected one-off charge

Hi Lee — thanks for flagging this and for the export. I pulled the invoice and usage window for your account. Short answer: this is a reconciliation true-up for the period Aug 15–Sept 14 tied to the expansion we processed in mid-August; the invoice includes two items: (1) retroactive top-up for committed capacity (Aug 15–Aug 31) and (2) an auto-applied overage for burst capacity incurred before the top-up fully provisioned.

We're compiling a short settlement summary that breaks the $18,700 into those two buckets and will add the recommended offset (one-off credit) we discussed during renewal. I expect to send the summary and a proposed single-line invoice adjustment tomorrow morning.

For next steps: can you confirm the PO number you want us to reference if we issue an adjusted invoice? Also cc'ing Marcus (finance) and Laura (account ops) to review credits and timing.

Attachment: acknowledged_usage_notes.txt (txt, 2 KB)

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, Lee Park <lee.park@streamforge.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-27T08:29:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity true-up and unexpected one-off charge

Lee / team — I reviewed the ledger entries and the provisioning events. Key notes: 
- Retro top-up (Aug 15–Aug 31): $6,300 — this is chargeback for committed capacity that was applied after the amendment effective date.
- Burst overage (Aug 20–Sep 3): $12,400 — this is legitimate overage on non-reserved capacity before autoscaling aligned with your new commitment.

We are prepared to apply a one-time goodwill credit of $4,500 against the overage portion to close the gap and preserve the relationship given the provisioning lag. That would reduce the payable from $18,700 to $14,200.

If Streamforge can provide a PO referencing RDW-4793, we will issue an adjusted invoice and a credit memo so your AP team can route payment. I'll include the credit memo and a short amortization table in the settlement PDF.

Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: ledger_extract_sep.pdf (pdf, 48 KB)
From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-29T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Internal — quick alignment on settlement proposal (Streamforge)

Laura / Ben — drafting the external summary now. Proposed language: 1) confirm $6,300 is retro top-up for the term change effective Aug 15; 2) confirm overage $12,400 and offer $4,500 one-time credit; 3) net adjusted amount $14,200 payable; 4) signed amendment (attached) remains effective and future usage will be billed per the new committed tier.

Questions: 
- Laura — can we absorb the credit to ARR or should it be a contra-revenue adjustment? The customer prefers a single adjusted invoice rather than a separate credit note.
- Ben — once Lee confirms PO, can you expedite issuance of the credit memo and adjusted invoice the same day? They want to close this week.

I'll send the external with the proposed wording after you confirm.

— Hannah
From: Lee Park <lee.park@streamforge.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: jenna.alvarez@streamforge.com, billing@streamforge.com
Date: 2026-09-30T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity true-up and unexpected one-off charge

Hannah — thanks for the clear breakdown. Streamforge will proceed on the adjusted amount of $14,200. PO will be issued today with PO# SF-2026-9876 and I will loop AP. Please reference RDW-4793 on the invoice. We appreciate the $4,500 credit — that resolves the majority of the concern.

Request: can you include the settlement summary PDF and the signed amendment reference in the invoice package so our auditors have the documentation? Once we receive the adjusted invoice and credit memo we'll route for payment.

Attachment: PO_SF-2026-9876.pdf (pdf, 36 KB)

Best —
Lee
